title: The Hidden Canvas
style: cinematic live-action film still, 35mm, shallow depth of field, realistic skin, natural light, emotional mood, vertical 9:16

narrator.look: Rahul, a man in his early 30s. Short, neat hair, clean-shaven, wearing a smart casual shirt.

father.look: Vijay, Rahul's father, in his 60s. Lean build, slightly graying hair, a kind but firm expression, usually in a simple kurta-pajama.

mother.look: Meera, Rahul's mother, in her 60s. Gentle face, warm eyes, traditional saree.

young_rahul.look: Rahul as a child/teenager, enthusiastic, often seen with a sketchbook.

scenes.image: Close-up on Rahul's face, eyes wide with shock, holding a faded, official-looking document.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Main hamesha sochta tha Papa ko mera art pasand nahi tha.
scenes.sub: I always thought Papa didn't like my art.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) sitting alone in his father's old study, looking pensive, surrounded by dusty books.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unke jaane ke baad, sach saamne aaya.
scenes.sub: After he passed away, the truth emerged.

scenes.image: Flashback: Young Rahul (young_rahul) excitedly showing a drawing to his father (father), who looks stern.
scenes.speaker: young_rahul
scenes.line: Papa, dekho maine kya banaya!
scenes.sub: Papa, look what I made!

scenes.image: Father (father) gently pushes the drawing away, gesturing towards a school book.
scenes.speaker: father
scenes.line: Rahul, padhai pe dhyan do. Art se pet nahi bharega.
scenes.sub: Rahul, focus on studies. Art won't fill your stomach.

scenes.image: Young Rahul (young_rahul) looks dejected, clutching his sketchbook to his chest.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mujhe bohot bura lagta tha. Unko meri kala samajh nahi aayi.
scenes.sub: I felt very bad. He didn't understand my art.

scenes.image: Flashback: Teenager Rahul (young_rahul) sketching intensely in his room, ignoring engineering textbooks.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mera sapna tha art school jaana, videsh mein padhna.
scenes.sub: My dream was to go to art school, study abroad.

scenes.image: Father (father) stands at the doorway, arms crossed, looking disappointed.
scenes.speaker: father
scenes.line: Engineering karo, beta. Future secure hoga.
scenes.sub: Do engineering, son. Your future will be secure.

scenes.image: Young Rahul (young_rahul) arguing with his father (father) in the living room, expressing frustration.
scenes.speaker: young_rahul
scenes.line: Par Papa, mujhe engineering nahi karni!
scenes.sub: But Papa, I don't want to do engineering!

scenes.image: Father (father) looks away, his face etched with worry, but remaining firm.
scenes.speaker: father
scenes.line: Yeh tumhare bhale ke liye hai.
scenes.sub: This is for your own good.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) now, looking at a framed photo of his father (father) on the table, a somber expression.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unhone kabhi meri suni hi nahi.
scenes.sub: He never listened to me.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) sitting in a modern office, looking bored at a computer screen with architectural designs.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aaj main ek successful engineer hoon, par khush nahi.
scenes.sub: Today I am a successful engineer, but not happy.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) in his old childhood bedroom, packing things into a box, feeling melancholic.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Papa ke baad ghar sambhalne aaya tha.
scenes.sub: I came to sort the house after Papa.

scenes.image: Close-up of Rahul's hand dusting off an old, wooden carving tool on a cluttered shelf.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unka workshop, unki adhoori kahani.
scenes.sub: His workshop, his unfinished story.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) opens a dusty, old wooden chest in the corner of the workshop.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Phir mujhe woh purani chest mili.
scenes.sub: Then I found that old chest.

scenes.image: Close-up inside the chest: old, intricate wooden carvings, partially finished, covered in sawdust.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Usme the unke apne adhure sapne.
scenes.sub: Inside were his own unfinished dreams.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) picks up a small, beautifully carved bird, examining it with a thoughtful look.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Papa ek adbhut karigar the.
scenes.sub: Papa was an amazing craftsman.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) finds a stack of faded black and white photographs under the carvings.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aur un tasveeron mein...
scenes.sub: And in those pictures...

scenes.image: Close-up on a photo: A young Vijay (father) proudly displaying his carvings at an art exhibition.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Young Papa, ek award-winning artist.
scenes.sub: Young Papa, an award-winning artist.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) stares at the photo, a look of surprise and dawning realization.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Yeh kya? Woh bhi artist the?
scenes.sub: What? He was an artist too?

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) sits down, sifting through more photos of his father carving and sketching.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unka passion, unki zindagi.
scenes.sub: His passion, his life.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) finds a small, locked wooden diary tucked beneath the photos.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Phir mili woh purani diary.
scenes.sub: Then I found that old diary.

scenes.image: Close-up of Rahul's trembling hands as he tries to open the diary, looking for a key.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Ek chhota sa taala laga tha uspar.
scenes.sub: It had a small lock on it.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) finds a tiny, ornate key hidden in a compartment of the chest.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Key bhi wahi thi.
scenes.sub: The key was also there.

scenes.image: Close-up of Rahul (narrator) carefully unlocking the diary, his face expectant.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mera dil tezi se dhadak raha tha.
scenes.sub: My heart was pounding rapidly.

scenes.image: First page of the diary: Elegant Hindi script, dated years ago.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unhone sab kuch likha tha.
scenes.sub: He had written everything.

scenes.image: Close-up on a page detailing his father's (father) struggle to choose between art and family responsibility.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Apni kala chhod di, mere liye.
scenes.sub: He gave up his art, for me.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) turns a page, eyes scanning the words, his expression shifting to confusion.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Par phir, ek ajeeb entry thi.
scenes.sub: But then, there was a strange entry.

scenes.image: Close-up on a diary entry mentioning 'Rahul's AAF application'.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: 'Rahul ki AAF application. Bahut paisa laga.'
scenes.sub: 'Rahul's AAF application. Cost a lot of money.'

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) looks up, bewildered. AAF Academy was the famous art school he dreamt of.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Yeh kaise ho sakta hai?
scenes.sub: How can this be?

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) finds a folded, official-looking document deep inside the diary.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aur uske andar, woh document.
scenes.sub: And inside it, that document.

scenes.image: Close-up on the document: An application form for 'AAF Academy of Fine Arts' with 'REJECTED' stamped on it.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Meri AAF Academy ki application.
scenes.sub: My AAF Academy application.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) looks at the rejection stamp, then at a receipt for an exorbitant 'application fee'.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aur ek receipt. Fees bohot zyada thi.
scenes.sub: And a receipt. The fees were very high.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) remembers his father's (father) stern face, then looks at the receipt, his confusion deepening.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unhone toh mujhe roka tha.
scenes.sub: He had stopped me.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) stands up abruptly, the diary and documents in hand, needing answers.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maa ko yeh sab batana hoga.
scenes.sub: I have to tell Maa all this.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) enters the living room, where his mother (mother) is sitting calmly.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maa, yeh dekho! Papa ne kya kiya tha?
scenes.sub: Maa, look at this! What did Papa do?

scenes.image: Mother (mother) takes the diary and documents, her expression turning sad.
scenes.speaker: mother
scenes.line: Rahul, beta... ab tak pata nahi chala tha?
scenes.sub: Rahul, son... you didn't know until now?

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) sits beside her, desperate for the truth, tears in his eyes.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Kya hai yeh sab, Maa?
scenes.sub: What is all this, Maa?

scenes.image: Mother (mother) gently places her hand on Rahul's (narrator) arm, her eyes filled with tears.
scenes.speaker: mother
scenes.line: Tumhare Papa ko sabse zyada tumhare sapne pyaare the.
scenes.sub: Your Papa loved your dreams the most.

scenes.image: Flashback: Father (father) in his younger days, showing off his prized carvings at an exhibition.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Woh khud ek kalakaar the.
scenes.sub: He himself was an artist.

scenes.image: Flashback: Father (father) looking worriedly at bills, then at young Rahul (young_rahul) happily sketching.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Par family ke liye unhone apna art chhod diya.
scenes.sub: But for family, he gave up his art.

scenes.image: Mother (mother) narrates, looking at the diary with fondness and sorrow.
scenes.speaker: mother
scenes.line: Jab tumne AAF mein jaane ki baat ki...
scenes.sub: When you talked about going to AAF...

scenes.image: Flashback: Father (father) looking at a brochure for AAF Academy, his face a mix of hope and despair.
scenes.speaker: mother
scenes.line: Woh tumhara sapna poora karna chahte the.
scenes.sub: He wanted to fulfill your dream.

scenes.image: Flashback: Father (father) showing a small, intricately carved statue to a buyer, looking sad as he hands it over.
scenes.speaker: mother
scenes.line: Unhone apni sabse pyari carvings bech di.
scenes.sub: He sold his most beloved carvings.

scenes.image: Close-up on the receipt for the AAF application fee, then at the photo of father's award-winning carvings.
scenes.speaker: mother
scenes.line: Woh application fees bahut zyada thi.
scenes.sub: Those application fees were very high.

scenes.image: Flashback: Father (father) silently sealing the application envelope, his face full of hope.
scenes.speaker: mother
scenes.line: Unhe laga tumhara admission ho jayega.
scenes.sub: He thought you would get admission.

scenes.image: Flashback: Father (father) opening the rejection letter, his face collapsing in heartbreak.
scenes.speaker: mother
scenes.line: Lekin tum reject ho gaye.
scenes.sub: But you were rejected.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) looks utterly devastated, tears streaming down his face, clutching the rejection letter.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maa, kya keh rahi ho?
scenes.sub: Maa, what are you saying?

scenes.image: Mother (mother) takes Rahul's (narrator) hand, her voice soft with sorrow.
scenes.speaker: mother
scenes.line: Woh tumhara dil nahi todna chahte the.
scenes.sub: He didn't want to break your heart.

scenes.image: Flashback: Father (father) looking at the rejection letter, then at young Rahul (young_rahul) sketching happily, a painful decision on his face.
scenes.speaker: mother
scenes.line: Unhone decide kiya, tumhe kabhi nahi batayenge.
scenes.sub: He decided, he would never tell you.

scenes.image: Flashback: Father (father) looking at the remaining money from the carvings sale, then at engineering college brochures.
scenes.speaker: mother
scenes.line: Jo paise bache, woh tumhari engineering ke liye lagaye.
scenes.sub: Whatever money was left, he put for your engineering.

scenes.image: Mother (mother) softly touches Rahul's (narrator) cheek, tears in her eyes.
scenes.speaker: mother
scenes.line: Unka dil toot gaya tha, Rahul.
scenes.sub: His heart was broken, Rahul.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) sobs uncontrollably, finally understanding the depth of his father's (father) sacrifice.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maine unko kitna galat samjha.
scenes.sub: I misunderstood him so much.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) goes back to the empty workshop, looking at his father's (father) tools.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unka gussa nahi, unka pyaar tha.
scenes.sub: It wasn't his anger, it was his love.

scenes.image: Close-up of Rahul's (narrator) hand picking up a half-finished wooden carving, his father's last project.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Ek adhoora sapna, ek adhoora pyaar.
scenes.sub: An unfinished dream, an unfinished love.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) sits at his father's (father) workbench, holding a carving tool, a look of resolve on his face.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aaj main samajh gaya, Papa.
scenes.sub: Today I understood, Papa.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) begins to carve, slowly, tentatively, in his father's (father) workshop.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aapka sapna, ab mera bhi hai.
scenes.sub: Your dream, now it's mine too.

scenes.image: Close-up on Rahul's (narrator) hands working the wood, then a slow pan to a framed photo of his father (father) smiling proudly.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unhone sab kuch diya, bina bataye.
scenes.sub: He gave everything, without telling.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) looks at the carving, then at the photo, a faint, sad smile on his face.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unka pyaar, us hidden canvas mein tha.
scenes.sub: His love, was in that hidden canvas.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) holds up a finished, small wooden sculpture, a beautiful bird taking flight.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unki legacy, mere haathon mein.
scenes.sub: His legacy, in my hands.

scenes.image: Rahul (narrator) places the carved bird next to his father's (father) photo, a single tear falling.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Shukriya, Papa.
scenes.sub: Thank you, Papa.

scenes.image: Close-up on the carved bird, then a slow zoom out to show Rahul's (narrator) hand covering his father's (father) photo lovingly.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Kya aapne kabhi apne parents ka aisa sacrifice dekha hai?
scenes.sub: Have you ever seen such a sacrifice from your parents?

caption: My Father Hated My Art... Then I Found This.
yt_title: My Father Hated My Art... Then I Found This.
description:
I thought my father disapproved of my artistic dreams. His actions always confused me. 
Years later, a hidden discovery changed everything I knew about his love and sacrifice. 
What sacrifices have your parents made that you only realized later?
comment_question: What sacrifices have your parents made that you only realized later?
